purpose: Select exactly one economically independent offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign091, before opening any Campaign092 minute source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_source_boundary.source: immutable accepted local Tushare 2019-2025 one-minute source and joint-clean stock-day identity

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures the scale-free allocation of price discovery between each within-half interbar open-versus-prior-close discontinuity and the destination bar's own high-low range over the same 238 opportunities. No terminal definition measures this exact boundary-versus-intrabar magnitude allocation.
Campaign041 already fixes the unweighted nonzero-gap absorption count, so changing its interval or complement would be rescue rather than a new mechanism.
Campaign016 and Campaign071 already fix signed correlation or reversal relationships between gaps and candle bodies.
Sign splits, activity weights, clock weights, morning/afternoon variants, thresholds, filters, regimes, fitted weights, models, and combinations would open an avoidable search family.
Campaign009 and Campaign091 already measure own-bar body/range geometry and cannot be rewindowed, reweighted, or combined as Campaign092.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_interbar_gap_discovery_share_238p
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A larger share of one-minute price discovery occurring discontinuously between adjacent bars rather than inside the destination bar indicates discrete information arrival whose repricing may continue from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: Within each 120-bar half, for j=1..119 set g_j=abs(ln(open_j/close_{j-1})) and r_j=ln(high_j/low_j) on the same destination bar. Pool the 238 pairs, let G=sum(g_j), R=sum(r_j), and return G/(G+R).
selected_candidate.time_grid: Require the complete raw 241-row source identity, select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, exclude 09:30, and reset at lunch. No lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock transition is formed.
selected_candidate.input_rule: Every selected open, high, low, and close must be finite and strictly positive with low<=open<=high and low<=close<=high. Exact zero gaps and exact zero destination ranges remain valid zero contributions.
selected_candidate.support_rule: Require all 240 selected bars and finite strictly positive G+R across the exact 238 pairs. Use no epsilon, pseudocount, dropped pair, minimum nonzero-pair count, threshold, or replacement.
selected_candidate.floating_point_rule: Use float64 natural-log arithmetic. Require a finite score in [0,1]; canonicalize only values within 1e-12 of zero or one.
selected_candidate.availability: Known only after the signal-session 15:00 bar; no later session, daily return, comparison value, Candidate49 observation, or provider request is used.

decision.required_next_step: Complete and bind one exhaustive no-value mechanism-overlap audit; then freeze the no-return protocol, implementation, tests, and fingerprints before any candidate value.
